% fig_margin_curve: stability margin M = max dtZ vs sigma/R (log-log).
% Data: fig_margin_curve/margin_points.csv (regenerated by
% scripts/p019_sigma_procedure.py figures) + fig_margin_curve/scales.csv.
% Encodings: color+shape = viscosity is COLOR (blue inviscid / vermillion
% viscous); marker SHAPE = startup class (circle screen / square production);
% FILL = outcome (filled ignited / open survivor); EDGE weight = M estimator
% (thick direct max_dtZ / thin proxy).  Compile: pdflatex (from this dir).
\documentclass[tikz]{standalone}
\usepackage{pgfplots}
\pgfplotsset{compat=1.17}
\definecolor{cinv}{HTML}{0072B2}   % inviscid (Okabe-Ito blue)
\definecolor{cvis}{HTML}{D55E00}   % viscous  (Okabe-Ito vermillion)
\definecolor{cref}{HTML}{707070}   % reference lines / annotations
\pgfplotsset{
  discard if not/.style 2 args={
    x filter/.append code={%
      \edef\tempa{\thisrow{#1}}\edef\tempb{#2}%
      \ifx\tempa\tempb\else\def\pgfmathresult{nan}\fi
    }
  },
}
% \mpts{screen01}{viscous01}{ignited01}{direct01}{style}
\newcommand\mpts[5]{%
  \addplot+[only marks, forget plot, #5,
    discard if not={screen01}{#1},
    discard if not={viscous01}{#2},
    discard if not={ignited01}{#3},
    discard if not={direct01}{#4}]
    table[col sep=comma, x=sigma_over_R, y=M]
    {fig_margin_curve/margin_points.csv};}
% scales.csv rows (fixed order): eps, sigma_eq_over_R, sigma_stab_over_R,
% sigma_0_over_R
\pgfplotstableread[col sep=comma]{fig_margin_curve/scales.csv}\scales
\pgfplotstablegetelem{0}{value}\of\scales \let\vEPS\pgfplotsretval
\pgfplotstablegetelem{1}{value}\of\scales \let\vSEQ\pgfplotsretval
\pgfplotstablegetelem{2}{value}\of\scales \let\vSSTAB\pgfplotsretval
\pgfplotstablegetelem{3}{value}\of\scales \let\vSZERO\pgfplotsretval
\begin{document}
\begin{tikzpicture}
\begin{axis}[
  width=12.2cm, height=8.6cm,
  xmode=log, ymode=log,
  xmin=0.012, xmax=0.11, ymin=2e-3, ymax=80,
  xtick={0.015,0.02,0.03,0.05,0.08},
  xticklabels={0.015,0.02,0.03,0.05,0.08},
  unbounded coords=discard,
  xlabel={core size $\sigma/R$},
  ylabel={stability margin $M=\max_{\mathrm{steps,\,particles}}\Delta t\,Z$},
  grid=major, grid style={cref!25, very thin},
  axis line style={cref!70},
  tick label style={font=\small}, label style={font=\small},
  legend style={font=\footnotesize, at={(0.985,0.985)}, anchor=north east,
    legend cell align=left, draw=cref!50, fill=white, fill opacity=0.9,
    text opacity=1, row sep=-1pt},
  legend columns=1,
]
% --- failure thresholds and pre-registered target ---
\addplot[cref, dashed, thin, domain=0.012:0.11, forget plot] {2.0}
  node[pos=0.03, above right, font=\scriptsize, text=cref]
  {$\Delta t Z=2$ (unconditional blow-up)};
\addplot[cref, dashed, thin, domain=0.012:0.11, forget plot] {1.0}
  node[pos=0.03, below right, font=\scriptsize, text=cref]
  {$\Delta t Z=1$ ($\sigma$ sign flip)};
\addplot[black, densely dotted, thick, domain=0.012:0.11, forget plot] {\vEPS}
  node[pos=0.03, above right, font=\scriptsize]
  {$\varepsilon=\vEPS$ (target)};
% --- initializer scales (vertical) ---
\draw[cref, dash dot, thin]
  (axis cs:\vSEQ,2e-3) -- (axis cs:\vSEQ,80)
  node[pos=0.02, above right, rotate=90, font=\scriptsize, text=cref]
  {$\sigma_{eq}$};
\draw[cref, dash dot, thin]
  (axis cs:\vSSTAB,2e-3) -- (axis cs:\vSSTAB,80)
  node[pos=0.02, above right, rotate=90, font=\scriptsize, text=cref]
  {$\sigma_{stab}$};
\draw[black, dash dot, semithick]
  (axis cs:\vSZERO,2e-3) -- (axis cs:\vSZERO,80)
  node[pos=0.02, above right, rotate=90, font=\scriptsize]
  {$\sigma_0=2\sigma_{eq}$};
% --- p-fit slope (P1 addendum): viscous NT36 survivors, from pfit.csv ---
\pgfplotstableread[col sep=comma]{fig_margin_curve/pfit.csv}\pfit
\pgfplotstablegetelem{1}{p_exponent}\of\pfit \let\vPEXP\pgfplotsretval
\pgfplotstablegetelem{1}{lnA}\of\pfit \let\vLNA\pgfplotsretval
\addplot[cvis!70, dashed, semithick, domain=0.028:0.055, forget plot]
  {exp(\vLNA)*x^(-\vPEXP)}
  node[pos=0.8, above right, font=\scriptsize, text=cvis!80!black]
  {$M\propto\sigma^{-\vPEXP}$ (survivors)};
% --- data: 16 filtered series (empty combos draw nothing) ---
% screens, inviscid
\mpts{1}{0}{0}{1}{mark=*, mark size=2.6pt,
  mark options={draw=cinv, fill=white, line width=1.0pt}}
\mpts{1}{0}{0}{0}{mark=*, mark size=2.2pt,
  mark options={draw=cinv, fill=white, line width=0.4pt}}
\mpts{1}{0}{1}{1}{mark=*, mark size=2.6pt,
  mark options={draw=cinv, fill=cinv, line width=1.0pt}}
\mpts{1}{0}{1}{0}{mark=*, mark size=2.2pt,
  mark options={draw=cinv, fill=cinv!60, line width=0.4pt}}
% screens, viscous
\mpts{1}{1}{0}{1}{mark=*, mark size=2.6pt,
  mark options={draw=cvis, fill=white, line width=1.0pt}}
\mpts{1}{1}{0}{0}{mark=*, mark size=2.2pt,
  mark options={draw=cvis, fill=white, line width=0.4pt}}
\mpts{1}{1}{1}{1}{mark=*, mark size=2.6pt,
  mark options={draw=cvis, fill=cvis, line width=1.0pt}}
\mpts{1}{1}{1}{0}{mark=*, mark size=2.2pt,
  mark options={draw=cvis, fill=cvis!60, line width=0.4pt}}
% production, inviscid
\mpts{0}{0}{0}{1}{mark=square*, mark size=2.4pt,
  mark options={draw=cinv, fill=white, line width=1.0pt}}
\mpts{0}{0}{0}{0}{mark=square*, mark size=2.0pt,
  mark options={draw=cinv, fill=white, line width=0.4pt}}
\mpts{0}{0}{1}{1}{mark=square*, mark size=2.4pt,
  mark options={draw=cinv, fill=cinv, line width=1.0pt}}
\mpts{0}{0}{1}{0}{mark=square*, mark size=2.0pt,
  mark options={draw=cinv, fill=cinv!60, line width=0.4pt}}
% production, viscous
\mpts{0}{1}{0}{1}{mark=square*, mark size=2.4pt,
  mark options={draw=cvis, fill=white, line width=1.0pt}}
\mpts{0}{1}{0}{0}{mark=square*, mark size=2.0pt,
  mark options={draw=cvis, fill=white, line width=0.4pt}}
\mpts{0}{1}{1}{1}{mark=square*, mark size=2.4pt,
  mark options={draw=cvis, fill=cvis, line width=1.0pt}}
\mpts{0}{1}{1}{0}{mark=square*, mark size=2.0pt,
  mark options={draw=cvis, fill=cvis!60, line width=0.4pt}}
% --- legend (encoding key, built explicitly) ---
\addlegendimage{only marks, mark=*, mark options={draw=cinv, fill=cinv}}
\addlegendentry{inviscid}
\addlegendimage{only marks, mark=*, mark options={draw=cvis, fill=cvis}}
\addlegendentry{viscous}
\addlegendimage{only marks, mark=*, mark options={draw=black, fill=black}}
\addlegendentry{filled: ignited (pre-onset $M$)}
\addlegendimage{only marks, mark=*, mark options={draw=black, fill=white}}
\addlegendentry{open: survivor}
\addlegendimage{only marks, mark=*, mark size=2.6pt,
  mark options={draw=black, fill=white, line width=1.0pt}}
\addlegendentry{bold edge: direct $\max\Delta tZ$}
\addlegendimage{only marks, mark=*, mark size=2.2pt,
  mark options={draw=black, fill=white, line width=0.4pt}}
\addlegendentry{thin edge: proxy $-\Delta\ln(\min\sigma/\sigma_0)$}
\addlegendimage{only marks, mark=square*,
  mark options={draw=black, fill=white}}
\addlegendentry{square: production startup}
\end{axis}
\end{tikzpicture}
\end{document}
